channel.title: SNMRush
channel.description: SNMRush is an SEO, AEO and GEO agency. We get brands ranked in search, cited in AI answers and mentioned where buyers ask questions.

item.title: llms.txt: what it does, what it doesn't, and whether to bother
item.description: A practical guide to llms.txt: what the proposed file is, which AI tools read it, how to write one, and why it is no substitute for good content.

item.title: Structured data for AI search: the schema that earns its keep
item.description: Which schema.org types help search and AI engines understand your brand, how to implement them honestly, and what structured data cannot do.

item.title: Entity building: how to make AI engines know who you are
item.description: How brands become clear entities for search and AI: consistent facts, official profiles, third-party sources and the questions only you can answer.

item.title: Earning citations and brand mentions in AI answers
item.description: Why third-party mentions shape how AI assistants describe brands, and a practical, honest playbook for earning them without spam.

item.title: Answer-first writing: how to structure pages AI can quote
item.description: A practical method for writing pages that answer the question in the first 50 words, so people stay and AI engines can quote you accurately.

item.title: How to measure AI visibility without fooling yourself
item.description: A repeatable method for tracking brand mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI Overviews, with the caveats that matter.

item.title: Finding the questions your audience actually asks
item.description: Why keyword lists miss the real questions behind AI searches, and how to build a question map from genuine audience conversation.

item.title: Standing out when AI makes every brand sound the same
item.description: Why generic AI content struggles to earn citations, and how evidence, point of view and audience language make a brand worth quoting.

item.title: SEO, AEO and GEO explained: one programme, three surfaces
item.description: Plain definitions of SEO, AEO and GEO, how they overlap, where they differ, and how to plan them as a single visibility programme.

item.title: AI Overviews and the changing click: what to do about it
item.description: How Google AI Overviews and AI Mode change search clicks, which queries are most affected, and how to stay visible and valuable.
